title: TwistedCoordinateSectionCoprojection
statement: Fix a finite commutative coefficient ring $A$, a scheme $T$, positive invertible $N$ annihilating $A$, and the Cartier zero section of the affine line. Use the ordinary maps of [def-pur-coordinate-section-ordinary-arrows]; the closed coprojection is constructed here as the counit mate below. Define closedTensorProjection on $W,M$ by the canonical proper projection followed by $s^*p^*M\simeq M$, retaining $W$. Define coprojectionMate by the closed exceptional transpose of inverse closedTensorProjection followed by identity tensor the actual closed counit. Define unitOrientation as the adjunct of the untwisted supported Cartier arrow. CoprojectionNormalization is the proposition that unitOrientation is invertible and, for each coefficient-unit or Tate input, the specified projections and coprojectionMate are invertible and the twisted orientation equals the tensor of unitOrientation with the identity, conjugated by the specified unitors. Define twistedTarget from $p^*M_r\otimes L_X[2]$ to $A_X(r+1)[2r+2]$ using the root-normalized Tate pullback and product, derived degree-zero tensor and even-shift addition of [def-trf-coordinate-counit-arrows], [def-trf-section-local-comparison-data]. The sign presentation is the same as [def-pur-coordinate-section-cartier-sign].
